About:

In this video, Amazon FBA seller Cynthia Wakeford from Sol La Vie Apparel openly shares her Amazon FBA failure, full cost breakdown, and the lessons she learned after losing money.

- Cynthia Wakeford explains how she started her Sol La Vie Apparel Amazon FBA private label brand, why she launched her first product, and how the business eventually failed
- Detailed Amazon FBA costs breakdown: Cynthia shares exactly how she spent $26,172.99 on inventory, samples, shipping, branding, photography, software, and Amazon fees
- Month-by-month Amazon FBA sales, revenue, and profit numbers, including how long it took before Cynthia realized her Amazon business was not profitable
- The biggest mistakes Cynthia Wakeford made with Amazon FBA: poor product research, choosing the wrong niche, manufacturer and supplier issues, and weak differentiation
- How Cynthia used Alibaba to source her product, what she looked for in suppliers, and what went wrong with quality, pricing, and minimum order quantities
- Amazon PPC advertising problems: overspending on ads, bad keyword targeting, high ACoS, and how ad spend turned small profits into big losses
- Discussion of using product research tools and keyword tools for Amazon FBA, and how misreading market demand and competition led to picking a losing product
- Emotional side of losing $26K on Amazon FBA: Cynthia Wakeford talks about stress, self-doubt, sunk costs, and the difficult decision to stop trying to save the product
- What Cynthia would do differently if she started Amazon FBA again: stricter product validation, better keyword research, more conservative inventory orders, and clearer profit targets

This honest Amazon FBA failure story with Cynthia Wakeford is packed with real Amazon seller data, private label product research tips, Alibaba sourcing advice, Amazon PPC lessons, cost breakdowns, and practical Amazon FBA keywords to help you avoid losing money on your first product and build a more profitable ecommerce business.
